messages:
Emma (CSE): Acme reported sudden 403s for rerank+embeddings after they enabled mTLS on their ingress. They say 'generation' still works but rerank/embeds return 403. Trace ID: req-8b2f... anyone seen header stripping like this?

Liam (eng-oncall): suspect Authorization JWT got mangled by the ingress. Can you paste the raw request headers (redact token) and a decoded JWT payload if possible?

Emma (CSE): pasted headers:
```
:method: POST
:authority: api.redwood.example
:scheme: https
authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi... (redacted)
x-forwarded-client-cert: By=... (mTLS)
content-type: application/json
```
Decoded JWT claims (redacted):
```
{"sub":"svc-acme-01","entitlements":["generate"],"iss":"auth.redwood"}
```
Note: rerank and embeddings missing from entitlements.

Liam (eng-oncall): ah, looks like the provisioning/issuer gave a token lacking 'rerank' and 'embeddings'. But why only after mTLS flip? Could be our proxy replacing the Authorization header with a service-side token. Do we have proxy config that exchanges client cert for a service token and doesn't copy entitlements?

Matt (infra): We recently enabled mTLS termination on the ALB sidecar -> envoy. Envoy has 'forward_client_cert_details' config. If it's set to sanitize or overwrite, it can drop headers. Also some setups replace 'Authorization' with 'X-Forwarded-Authorization'. Does Acme's sidecar drop 'Authorization' when client cert present?

Emma (CSE): I asked customer to curl with -v to show headers they send and what reaches us. They replied with curl -v from their host showing Authorization present. But our access logs show Authorization header empty for that request. Trace id above. 

Liam (eng-oncall): Ok please ask customer to replay with `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" --trace-ascii -` and include the server-side request id. Meanwhile I'll check ingress logs for req-8b2f...

(10m later)

Liam (eng-oncall): Found it. Envoy filter "sanitize_headers" was set to true in the mTLS route config for tenant routes, and it strips Authorization when client cert is present. That filter also triggers our provisioner to issue a new short-lived svc token WITHOUT entitlements (bug). Repro: enable mTLS, send req with Authorization-> result vault_token header shows svc- token with empty entitlements.

Matt (infra): Repro steps for dev:
```
# start envoy with mTLS+sanitize_headers=true
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ey..." -v https://staging.redwood/internal/test
# check staging access logs show Authorization missing
```

Liam (eng-oncall): Hotfix: disable sanitize_headers for tenant routes and re-run provisioner to preserve original Authorization passthrough. Longer-term: change provisioner to copy entitlements from incoming JWT when exchanging.

Emma (CSE): I'll notify Acme and ask them to try again. Can we patch infra config now? This is causing production customer impact.

Matt (infra): I'll roll a config change to disable sanitize on the route in the next 10 mins, will post rollback plan.

Emma (CSE): :raised_hands: thanks. Will update ticket and mark as P1

Liam (eng-oncall): follow-up: create a unit test for the provisioner that validates entitlements-preserved when client cert auth path used. Filed GH-3345

Emma (CSE): GH-3345 link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/provisioner/pull/3345 (draft)

Matt (infra): Config applied, monitoring looks good. Acme confirmed rerank and embeddings now succeed. Closing triage but follow-ups for provisioner change remain.

Emma (CSE): closing thread, will attach postmortem notes to the ticket.
